title: Guys Expansion Pack 1
description: Seven more glossy emoji faces, from a cyclops to a blushing smiley.
llm_description: Glossy yellow 3D cartoon emoji faces with bold shading: a one-eyed cyclops with fangs, a blushing smiley, a tongue-out goof, a plain grin, a worried groaning face, a manic wide-eyed grin and a long-nosed sad face.
